commit.message:
feat: run Codex worker visual QA for generated MS screenshots (#1491)

Visually inspect all 424 page-level MS screenshots from #1490 and emit the
Codex worker visual QA receipt that gates student-display promotion.

Every screenshot was inspected via 24 orientation-grouped contact sheets.
Sheets are grouped by orientation and letterboxed: mark-scheme content pages
are A4 landscape while cover pages are portrait, so a fixed portrait cell
would have drawn landscape pages at half linear resolution and made legibility
depend on page shape rather than on the render.

Deterministic pixel pre-checks (blankness, geometry against the source PDF
page viewport, hash provenance, colour-overlay geometry) bound reviewer effort
but never grant a pass. The upstream locator was produced by a question-label
regex over the PDF text layer, so that text layer is deliberately not re-read
here: doing so would re-confirm the very evidence under review. Row/page
alignment was judged by reading printed question labels off the rendered page.

Counts: 407 visual_qa_pass, 6 visual_qa_fail, 11 visual_qa_blocked,
0 needs_manual_review; 28 row_page_match_pass, 6 wrong_page.

Two defect classes found:

- 6 assets are clean renders of the wrong page. The locator aimed question
  rows at generic front matter (marking principles, mark scheme notes,
  abbreviations), whose numbered 1..6 list the regex read as question numbers.
- 11 assets carry a third-party redistribution watermark that explicitly
  claims the questions were modified. The renders are faithful, so these are
  blocked on source provenance rather than failed on render quality. The set is
  re-derived from pixel geometry and cross-checked against the reviewer's
  declared list; a mismatch fails the validator. Colour alone is not the
  signal: 8 further pages carry legitimate coloured figures and are unaffected.

student_display_allowed remains false for all 424 assets; this receipt gates
promotion and does not perform it. No OCR, VLM, or external model call.
Contact sheets stay in the gitignored controlled package.

Closes #1491
